description: Plugin assignments for sync-to-plugin.sh. Maps each item in the extracted prompts/ output to its target plugin subdirectory.

ag-prompt.description: Prompt/agentic tooling engineering — rules, skills, subrepo sync

ag-pm.description: Product management — tickets, requirements, PRD publishing

ag-eng.description: Engineering — code, testing, debugging, examples, docs, git, PRs, performance

ag-rel.description: Release management — release notes, blog, options review, triage

ag-charts.description: AG Charts product-specific — chart docs, series performance, visual QA

notes.localItems: The following items currently in .rulesync/ (local tier) stay local and are NOT in any plugin: skills[releases, technology-stack, triage-rt, triage-rt-board, writing-style], commands[docs-review, release-docs-review, release-summary]. These appear alongside plugin skills as bare /name (no namespace conflict because plugin items use /ag-*:name).
notes.directCommits: The 6 agents in ag-charts (data-viz-designer, example-tester, previs-evaluator, technical-research-analyst, test-writer, visual-qa) and all ag-charts skills/commands are direct commits to ag-dev-prompts — they must be placed in plugins/ag-charts/ or plugins/ag-pm/ or plugins/ag-eng/ when committed.
notes.excludedFromPlugin: hooks/, .mcp.json, .claude-settings.json, .cursor-worktrees.json are excluded (conflict with project settings when loaded as plugin).
